name: Sam bo luong
summary: Sâm bổ lượng is the drink on Phạm Hồng Thái at night, listed with mì Quảng, ốc hút, sinh tố, and chè.
howToEat: Order it on the night street.
where: Phạm Hồng Thái. The 2019 account prints 17:00–23:00 and says the street runs from about 17:00 until after 23:00.
seoTitle: Sam bo luong — a night drink on Pham Hong Thai
seoDescription: Sâm bổ lượng is the drink on Phạm Hồng Thái at night, listed with chè and sinh tố.
